Title: ReconnectModal Component
Summary: Modal dialog for Blazor Server circuit reconnection states with retry and resume controls.
Content:
## ReconnectModal.razor **Path:** `Components/Layout/ReconnectModal.razor` **Type:** Shared component (no `@page` directive) ### Purpose Displays a modal dialog when the Blazor Server SignalR circuit is interrupted, providing visual feedback and retry/resume controls. ### Structure ```razor

Rejoining the server...

Rejoin failed... trying again in seconds.

Failed to rejoin.
Please retry or reload the page.

The session has been paused by the server.

Failed to resume the session.
Please retry or reload the page.

``` ### States | CSS Class | State | Description | |-----------|-------|-------------| | `.components-reconnect-first-attempt-visible` | First reconnection attempt | Shows "Rejoining the server..." | | `.components-reconnect-repeated-attempt-visible` | Repeated attempts | Shows countdown timer | | `.components-reconnect-failed-visible` | Reconnection failed | Shows "Failed to rejoin" + Retry button | | `.components-pause-visible` | Session paused by server | Shows "The session has been paused" + Resume button | | `.components-resume-failed-visible` | Resume failed | Shows "Failed to resume" + Resume button | ### JavaScript Module The component references `ReconnectModal.razor.js` which handles: - Showing/hiding the modal based on circuit state - Updating the countdown timer - Wiring the Retry and Resume buttons ### Accessibility - `aria-hidden="true"` on the animation div prevents screen readers from announcing decorative elements. - `data-nosnippet` prevents search engines from indexing reconnection text. ### Usage Rendered in `App.razor` immediately after ``: ```razor ``` ### Notes - This is a **framework-level component** — its visibility is controlled by Blazor's internal circuit reconnection logic, not by component state. - The `dialog` element is used natively for modal behavior (focus trapping, backdrop). - CSS classes are toggled by the Blazor framework JavaScript, not by Razor `@if` conditions.
